AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Trusted administrator membership record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin record was created.

PublishedSiteConfig.title: PublishedSiteConfig
PublishedSiteConfig.description: Live website copy across all steps, top bars, modals, and ordered list of published owner letter IDs visible in real-time to all visitors.

authorUid.description: UID of the verified admin who published the update.

letterOrderIds.description: Ordered list of published owner letter IDs (1 to 30 items).

globalBars.description: Top bar control labels including admin login button and sound status labels.

stepA.description: Step A identity confirmation UI copy fields.

stepB.description: Step B birthday gate UI copy fields.

stepC.description: Step C letter desk and mailbox UI copy fields.

stepD.description: Step D reply editor and modal UI copy fields.

stepE.description: Step E envelope folding and thank-you UI copy fields.

PublishedLetter.title: PublishedLetter
PublishedLetter.description: Public owner letter displayed in real-time on the letter desk and mailbox for all verified visitors.

id.description: Unique letter identifier matching the document ID.

authorUid.description: UID of the verified admin who saved this letter.

isOwnerApprovedForProduction.description: Explicit production visibility flag enforced on real-time collection queries.

senderLabel.description: Sender label displayed on the envelope.

dateLabel.description: Date or recipient label displayed on the letter.

paragraphs.description: Bounded list of paragraph strings (1 to 80 paragraphs).

SharedReplyLetter.title: SharedReplyLetter
SharedReplyLetter.description: Real-time shared reply letter in the mailbox readable by everyone after birthday verification and editable by original writer (via Auth UID or split-collection cryptographic lock) or Admin.

letterId.description: Unique reply letter identifier matching the document ID.

authorUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of creator, or 'guest_writer' when paired with a split-collection ReplyWriterLock.

lastEditorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of latest editor or 'guest_writer'.

lockNonce.description: Synchronized monotonic nonce matching /reply_locks/{replyId}.nonce (0 when created by a verified Auth user without guest lock).

visibility.description: Explicit public visibility marker enforced on list and get queries.

title.description: Display title of the reply letter.

author.description: Display pen-name of the letter writer (no PII).

body.description: Body content of the reply letter.

recoveryState.description: Envelope state of the reply letter.

ReplyWriterLock.title: ReplyWriterLock
ReplyWriterLock.description: Private write-only capability lock (Pillar 6 Split Collection) enabling unauthenticated birthday-verified writers to update/remove only their own reply letter via atomic writeBatch without exposing secrets in public documents.

secretKey.description: Immutable 256-bit hex secret stored exclusively in this unreadable collection.

nonce.description: Strictly monotonic counter incremented by +1 on every guest writer mutation.

proof.description: Dynamic write proof equal to secretKey + '_' + string(nonce) proving caller possession of secretKey on every update.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted admin registry keyed by UID; immutable from client SDK.

/published_site/{configId}.description: Singleton live_site document containing complete UI copy for every screen and ordered owner letter IDs.

/published_letters/{letterId}.description: Published owner letters (apology, birthday, and admin-created letters) streamed in real-time where isOwnerApprovedForProduction == true.

/shared_replies/{replyId}.description: Real-time shared reply letters streamed where visibility == 'public', writable by original writer (via Auth or atomic ReplyWriterLock) or Admin.

/reply_locks/{replyId}.description: Unreadable (get/list false) capability lock collection paired atomically with guest-authored /shared_replies/{replyId} documents.
